r-ongoing::c-0.html: Open PLAY session, OR concrete start in progress, OR a contained child is ongoing (rollup)

r-ongoing::c-3.html: Open PLAY session, OR concrete start passed & not yet ended

r-complete::c-3.html: Its end has passed; glyph fills, awaits close

r-complete::c-4.html: Reached its max occurrences (marks + a passed at); default max 1

r-closed::c-0.html: Closed — filed at the stamped midnight (fills + fades)

r-closed::c-1.html: Closed — filed at midnight after Done (fills + fades)

r-closed::c-3.html: Closed at the next midnight (fills + fades)

r-closed::c-4.html: Closed at the next midnight (fills + fades)

r-cancelled::c-0.html: Called off — bar over glyph + strike + fade

r-cancelled::c-1.html: Called off — bar over glyph + strike + fade

r-enter::c-0.html: Auto-opens a PLAY session ⇒ spins + DURATION counts; ACCESS (presence) also ticks

r-enter::c-1.html: Auto-PLAY while undone ⇒ spins; a Done task is presence-only (ACCESS ticks, no spin)

r-enter::c-3.html: Presence only (ACCESS ticks); does NOT auto-play

r-glyphclick::c-1.html: Spinning ⇒ Stop; resting + undone ⇒ Done; done ⇒ un-done (resumes if still open)

r-glyphclick::c-3.html: Idle ⇒ Play (manual stopwatch, activity rail); spinning ⇒ Stop

r-glyphclick::c-4.html: Mark — adds one occurrence; glyph flashes its fill once

r-play::c-0.html: Play ⇒ open a play session; Stop ⇒ close it (records on the activity rail)

r-play::c-3.html: Play ⇒ open a play session; Stop ⇒ close it

r-mark::c-4.html: Append a zero-length occurrence toward the tally. --maxnb:3 soft cap, --maxnbhard:3 hard cap; default max 1 = a unique occurrence

r-sources::c-0.html: ① open play · ② concrete started span · ③ rollup from a contained child

r-sources::c-1.html: ① open play (focus/viewing never flips state)

r-sources::c-3.html: ① open play · ② concrete started span

r-mruyayc3-0::c-6.html:
Alive via PUBLISH — a Organism becomes alive when it is published (right-click → Publish; the `publishedAt` stamp is its birth, the parallel to an Individual’s born date). Before that it is a draft: open, or scheduled/expected if it has a future founding start.

Deletable only while NOT alive (open / scheduled / cancelled) — a published (live) Organism cannot be deleted, only Unpublished back to a draft. Closing a live one ⇒ dead (age = published→dead); closing a draft ⇒ plain closed.

v0 → SHIPPED. New state alive; publishedAt field + Publish/Unpublish menu toggle (any kind except Soul); guards canDeleteEntity/canCancelEntity are life-being-aware (isLifeBeing); published, life-status (upcoming/live) + age render in §0. NOT tied to the Sessions rework.

r-mruyayc3-0::c-7.html:
Alive via PUBLISH — a Community becomes alive when it is published (right-click → Publish; the `publishedAt` stamp is its birth, the parallel to an Individual’s born date). Before that it is a draft: open, or scheduled/expected if it has a future founding start.

Deletable only while NOT alive (open / scheduled / cancelled) — a published (live) Community cannot be deleted, only Unpublished back to a draft. Closing a live one ⇒ retired (age = published→retired); closing a draft ⇒ plain closed.

v0 → SHIPPED. New state alive; publishedAt field + Publish/Unpublish menu toggle (any kind except Soul); guards canDeleteEntity/canCancelEntity are life-being-aware (isLifeBeing); published, life-status (upcoming/live) + age render in §0. NOT tied to the Sessions rework.
